description: This file defines a PHP class WorkShiftStartAndEndTime within the namespace OrangeHRM\Admin\Dto. The class encapsulates start and end times for a work shift using DateTime objects, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: WorkShiftStartAndEndTime
